# Forrest Shriver
[...]
After receiving his doctorate, Forrest decided to pursue his passion in bringing advanced & decentralized intelligence to industrial applications and facilities by founding Sentinel Devices LLC. He’s worked on multiple projects ranging from low-level code optimization to high-performance computing and artificial intelligence applications, for a variety of objectives including advanced simulations and nuclear non-proliferation . He brings almost a decade of software engineering and architecture experience in his role as technical lead and CEO of Sentinel Devices LLC. In this capacity, he oversees the machine learning & software optimization efforts of the company, enabling the next-generation capabilities of our platform.

items.title: tyagiprnv/Sentinel
items.snippet:
# Repository: tyagiprnv/Sentinel
[...]
GenAI-powered PII redaction gateway for enterprise compliance. Sentinel combines NLP detection, policy-based compliance (HIPAA/PCI-DSS/GDPR), and intelligent risk scoring to protect sensitive data.
[...]
**GenAI-powered PII redaction gateway for enterprise compliance.**
[...]
Sentinel combines NLP detection, policy-based compliance (HIPAA/PCI-DSS/GDPR), and intelligent risk scoring to protect sensitive data. Unlike traditional redaction tools, Sentinel provides nuanced risk assessments, automatic policy recommendations, and explainable AI decisions—making compliance both secure and operationally flexible.
[...]
# Restore with authentication
curl -X POST http://localhost:8000/restore \
  -H "X-API-Key: your_key" \
  -d '{"redacted_text": "Contact [REDACTED_a1b2]"}'
[...]
redacted_text
[...]
, risk scores
[...]
# 2. Redact with recommended policy
curl -X POST http://localhost:8000/redact \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "text": "Patient John Doe, DOB: 1990-05-15, SSN: 123-45-6789",
    "policy": {"context": "healthcare"}
  }'

# Response:
{
  "redacted_text": "Patient [REDACTED_701dac], DOB: [REDACTED_37e3d8], SSN: [REDACTED_889083]",
  "confidence_scores": {"PERSON": 0.95, "DATE_TIME": 0.85, "US_SSN": 1.0},
  "policy": {
    "context": "healthcare",
    "restoration_allowed": false
  }
}
[...]
- `POST /redact` - Redact PII with policy-based filtering
- `POST /restore` - **[AUTH]** Restore original text from tokens
- `POST /suggest-policy` - **[GenAI]** Get AI-powered policy recommendation
- `GET /policies` - List available policy contexts
- `GET /metrics` - Prometheus metrics (includes risk distributions)
